correctness.rationale: Associativity and nilpotency correspond exactly to concatenated strict chains. At height≤3 the unary-only or no-length-two-walk binary template has finite duality. At height≥4, the specific odd-cycle orientations have no strict-interval homomorphism by forced endpoint equality, whereas each proper induced subgraph maps into the available directed three-vertex path. Wang–Yin–Wang Theorem 1.1 and Lemma 3.3 prove the finite-basis iff. The quantitative witness additionally invokes their Theorem 4.1. Finite checker executed on all 5231 posets in fixed linear-extension coordinates through six vertices and on odd cycles up to size17; finite tests support but do not establish the infinite argument.

value.rationale: This gives a complete sharp height-only finite-basis classification for a large natural family of finite nilpotent semigroups (all finite posets, arbitrary width and branching), explicit unbounded obstruction families, and a direct comparison with Gao–Zhou flat interval semirings that share the identical multiplicative reduct yet have a sharply different answer for chains. It refines, rather than mechanically restates, the published general criterion and small three-chain example.
